units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:1:10">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>עד שיִכְמוֹשוּ</he> until they are withered.—Part. pass. <he>כָּמוּשׁ</he>, f. <cite ref="K01002"><he>כְּמוּשָׁה</he></cite>; pl. <he>כְּמוּשִׁין</he>, <he>כְּמוּשׁוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:2">Cant. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>מה שושנה … והיא כ׳ וכ׳</he> as the lily, when the heat comes upon it, is withered, but blooms again when the dew falls … <he>נראין כ׳ וכ׳</he> so does Israel … seem to be withered &c.
<cite ref="Sukkah 31a:17">Succ. 31ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כמושין</he> withered fruits, contrad. to <he>יבשין</he> dried up; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1">Cant. R. to II, 1</cite> <he>נוחה להִכָּמֵשׁ</he> withers easily.
